name: Button
summary: Trigger an action or navigation — the primary interactive control.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-button> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens, so every button reads identically across apps and even outside one. Variants and sizes are attributes; there is one rendered UI, not a per-framework look-alike.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue consumes the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Sizes
spec.value: sm 28 (r4) · md 36 (r8) · lg 40 (r8, default) · xl 52 (r12, padding 28) · touch 48 (r8, padding 24) — heights; fontSize 14 (sm/md) / 16 (lg/xl/touch)

spec.label: Primary
spec.value: bg #E70E68, label #FFFFFF, hover #DB005B + soft pink shadow, active #DB005B without the hover shadow

spec.label: Secondary
spec.value: white bg, #1A1A1A label, 1px #E3E3E3 border; hover pale pink #FEF3F7 + #E70E68 border, label stays #1A1A1A

spec.label: Tertiary / Link
spec.value: transparent; tertiary hover #FEF3F7, active #FEF3F7, label #1A1A1A; link #000000 weight 400, underlined at rest, hover #E70E68

spec.label: Danger
spec.value: black fill #000000, white label, hover #303030, active #4A4A4A — a destructive action; never the primary button, the safe choice beside it is

spec.label: Success
spec.value: black outline: white fill, 1px #000000 border, black label, hover fill #F7F7F7, active fill #E3E3E3 — a done / confirmed state

spec.label: Positive
spec.value: Vivid Pink like primary: bg #E70E68, white label, hover #DB005B + soft pink shadow, active #DB005B — Upgrade and other encouraging actions

spec.label: Primary-alt
spec.value: same fill as primary #E70E68 (a second primary slot for a two-primary layout)

spec.label: Text / Text-link
spec.value: white bg, no border, weight 400; text = secondary-grey label, hover grey fill; text-link = #000000 label underlined at rest, hover #E70E68

spec.label: Label / icon
spec.value: Plus Jakarta Sans SemiBold 600, 14 (sm/md) / 16 (lg/xl/touch); icon 16px, inline-flex, 8px gap

spec.label: Focus
spec.value: 2px solid ring outside a 2px gap (box-shadow) — Vivid Pink #E70E68, 4.51:1 on white · black on danger and success. Re-point --aha-button-focus-ring / --aha-button-focus-gap on a dark surface

spec.label: Icon-only
spec.value: square (width = height per size: 28/36/40/52), glyph centred, no label; needs aria-label

props.name: variant
props.type: primary | secondary | tertiary | link | danger | success | positive | primary-alt | text | text-link
props.desc: tone × emphasis; one primary per view. Status carries no hue, so danger (black fill), success (black outline) and positive (Vivid Pink) differ by shape; primary-alt is a synonym of primary; text / text-link are borderless label buttons

props.name: size
props.desc: 28 / 36 / 40 / 52 / 48px height — lg (40) is the default; xl (52) is for presenter controls rendered inside a slide canvas and read from room distance (the web-component twin of React <XLButtonScope>); touch (48, 8px corners, 16px label) is the audience phone's primary action and clears the 44px touch floor

props.name: icon
props.desc: leading glyph via <span slot="icon">; for icon-only, the glyph is the default child

whenToUse.when: the single most important action on a view (one per screen)
the default for most actions — neutral, white with a border
low-emphasis or inline navigation, no container weight
a destructive action (delete, remove) — pair with a confirm
a done or confirmed state shown as a button (Saved, Connected)
an encouraging action such as Upgrade
a compact action where the glyph is self-explanatory (close, more, add) — always give an aria-label
a presenter control drawn inside the slide canvas (Reveal, Next, Start) that the room reads from a distance — not for app screens, where lg is the ceiling

opinion.note: Size: LARGE (lg) is the default for most actions; step down to MEDIUM (md) or SMALL (sm) in denser/secondary regions to lower an action's information-hierarchy, not by whim. Size only via the size attribute (sm / md / lg / xl) — never inline height/padding/radius/fontSize, and never through ::part(button). Recolour only by setting --aha-color-primary (plus the --aha-button-primary-* hover, press and text tokens) on the document root. Primary fill is #E70E68; hover #DB005B per DS V3.
opinion.dsv3: <aha-button> binds to a NAMED button semantic-token layer (--aha-button-*): --aha-button-primary-bg/-bg-hover/-bg-press/-text, --aha-button-default-bg/-text/-border/-bg-hover/-border-hover/-border-press, --aha-button-ghost-bg-hover/-bg-press (tertiary), --aha-button-danger-bg/-bg-hover/-bg-press/-text/-ring, --aha-button-positive-bg/-bg-hover/-bg-press/-text, --aha-button-disabled-bg/-text, --aha-button-focus-ring/-focus-ring-success, --aha-button-elevate-primary/-secondary. Each is a pure indirection whose value references the core DS token (e.g. --aha-button-primary-bg: var(--aha-color-primary)), so button theming can move independently of the core palette with NO visual change — the rendered colours are byte-identical to the raw --aha-btn-* seeds.
